title: x402 Stage Result
description: The result of a single stage in the x402 reliability verification pipeline

passed.description: True = passed, false = failed, null = skipped or unattempted

latency_ms.description: Time in milliseconds for this stage to complete

error.description: Error message if the stage failed or threw an exception

error_code.description: Machine-readable code for a failed stage, e.g. ZERO_PRICE or INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE (SPEC.md, Error Codes)

fault.description: Who a failure is attributed to: the service, or the checker (checker-side error). null when the stage passed or was skipped

network.description: Blockchain network, exactly as the service sent it (stages 3, 5)

x402_version.description: x402 protocol version of the payment terms (stage 3)

terms_source.description: Where the payment terms were read from (stage 3)

facilitator_url.description: Facilitator URL the service published, or null (stage 3)

price_usdc.description: Price in USDC as a decimal number (stage 4)

price_atomic_units.description: Whether the advertised price was read as atomic units of the asset (stage 4)

tx_hash.description: On-chain transaction hash from the service's settlement receipt; null when there is no receipt. Never invented (stage 5)

payment_header.description: Header the payment was sent in (stage 5)

settlement_status.description: What the service's settlement receipt says (stage 5)

receipt_header.description: Header the settlement receipt came from (stage 5)

response_status.description: HTTP status code of the paid response (stage 5)

body_bytes.description: Size in bytes of the response body (stage 6)

schema_url.description: URL of the schema used for validation (stage 7)
